related_questions.question: How long do COVID vaccine side effects last?

text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 vaccine side effects are typically mild and temporary, usually lasting only one to three days. While some individuals experience no side effects, others may have mild reactions like pain or swelling at the injection site, fatigue, headache, muscle pain, chills, fever, or nausea. These side effects are a normal sign that your body is building protection. If side effects are severe or persistent, or if you experience emergency warning signs like trouble breathing or persistent chest pain, seek medical advice.
